name: Wren's Garden
description: Old Wren the herbalist can't reach her garden. The Thornlings have opinions about that.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: You there, with the dragon! My herb garden is overrun. Thornlings, everywhere, being rude.
intro.name: Old Wren

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: We'll clear a path.

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *sniffs a Thornling, sneezes on it*

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A Bog Hopper has claimed the garden pond. It is sitting on the mint.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Not the mint!
intro.name: Old Wren

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: My garden! Take these, dear. Potions taste better when the mint is fresh.
outro.name: Old Wren

outro.speaker: dragon
outro.text: *eats a basil plant, looks very pleased with itself*

name: The Spore Cloud
description: A cloud of glowing spores is drifting toward the village. Wren wants a sample. So does everyone else.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Those Spore Puffers are making the whole Hollow sneeze. Bring me a jar of spores, would you?
intro.name: Old Wren

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: How hard can it be to catch a cloud?

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Two Moss Wisps zip in to guard the biggest Puffer. They glow menacingly. Mostly glow.

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *tries to eat a wisp, gets a mouth full of light*

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: You hold up a jar of glowing spores. They hum.

outro.speaker: rider
outro.text: Wren wanted these. But a trader in town pays good gold for glowing things.

choice.prompt: What do you do with the jar of spores?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Oh, splendid! I'll brew something that makes dragons glow in the dark. Here, have some embers I found.
lines.name: Old Wren

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The trader pays in shiny coins and asks no questions. Your dragon looks a little disappointed in you.

name: Elder of the Thicket
description: The oldest Thornling in the Hollow wants a word. A loud, pointy word.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A Barkback Boar blocks the path to the thicket, chewing a log thoughtfully.

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: Excuse us!

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: It does not excuse you.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: In the heart of the thicket, the Elder Thornling rises. It has a beard of twigs.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Who disturbs the thicket? The spore-thief and the sneezing lizard?
intro.name: Elder Thornling

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *sneezes, on purpose this time*

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: Fine. FINE. You are strong. The Troll beyond the brambles is stronger. Hah.
outro.name: Elder Thornling

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: It drops a lump of iron ore and stomps off, offended.

name: The Bramble Troll
description: The Bramble Troll has been hoarding the Hollow's sunshine. Time to share.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: The Troll's brambles block the light. My herbs are wilting. So am I.
intro.name: Old Wren

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: We're on it.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A pair of guards steps out of the brambles.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The brambles part. The Bramble Troll is sitting on a pile of stolen garden gnomes.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: MINE. All the gnomes. All the sun.
intro.name: Bramble Troll

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *growls in a way that is almost brave*

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: Sunlight floods the Hollow. Somewhere, a gnome is returned to a grateful garden.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: You've done it! The Hollow will sing about you. Badly, but with feeling.
outro.name: Old Wren

outro.speaker: rider
outro.text: Where to next, partner?

outro.speaker: dragon
outro.text: *points its nose toward the sea*

name: Captain Pell's Boat
description: Captain Pell's boat is stuck on a sandbar. The crabs say it's theirs now.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Ahoy! My boat, the Soggy Biscuit, is surrounded by crabs. Very rude crabs.
intro.name: Captain Pell

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: We've dealt with rude before.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A Gull Bandit swoops down and steals Pell's hat.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: MY HAT!
intro.name: Captain Pell

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: You saved the Biscuit AND the hat. Here's something for your trouble.
outro.name: Captain Pell

outro.speaker: dragon
outro.text: *tries on the hat. It does not fit.*

name: The Slime Tide
description: Brine Slimes are oozing up the beach at night. Pell thinks something is sending them.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Every night, more slime. Every morning, more mopping. I'm a captain, not a mop!
intro.name: Captain Pell

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: Let's find where they come from.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The trail of slime leads into the kelp beds. Something large is wearing the kelp as a coat.

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *pokes the kelp. The kelp pokes back.*

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: Behind the Kelp Lurker you find a chest, half-buried, with a map inside.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: That's the old salvage map! It shows a wreck full of gold. Or a lighthouse that needs help. The ink's smudged.
outro.name: Captain Pell

outro.speaker: rider
outro.text: Two marks. We can only reach one before the tide.

choice.prompt: The tide is coming in. Which mark do you follow?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You find a soggy chest of coins. Your dragon guards it like it hatched it.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Bless you! The light's been out for a week. Take these, they fell from the stars. Probably.
lines.name: Keeper Mae

name: The Shell Knight's Oath
description: A Shell Knight challenges you to an honorable duel. Its honor is mostly shell.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: HALT! I am Sir Clamsworth, Shell Knight of the Third Tide. I challenge thee!
intro.name: Sir Clamsworth

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: Is this really necessary?

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: VERY.
intro.name: Sir Clamsworth

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Thou fightest well. But canst thou best my squire?
intro.name: Sir Clamsworth

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The squire is a crab. It is a very big crab. It is Big Pincher.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: I yield! Know this: the Crab King stirs in his tide pool. He has heard of thee. He is cross.
outro.name: Sir Clamsworth

outro.speaker: dragon
outro.text: *clacks its jaws like a crab, badly*

name: The Crab King
description: The Crab King wants the whole shore. And Pell's boat. And, oddly, the hat.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: He's sent his whole court to the docks! Crabs, gulls, the lot.
intro.name: Captain Pell

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: Then we go to him.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The Crab King rises from his tide pool, crown gleaming, claws snapping.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Bow to the King of the Shore! Also give me that hat.
intro.name: Crab King

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: NEVER.
intro.name: Captain Pell

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: The Crab King scuttles back into the sea, crownless and grumbling.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: The shore is free! The Soggy Biscuit sails again!
outro.name: Captain Pell

outro.speaker: dragon
outro.text: *stands at the front of the boat, very proud, gets splashed*

name: Lost in the Fog
description: Ferryman Bo has lost his way in his own marsh. That has never happened before. He says.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Ahoy, keeper! The fog rolled in thick and now every reed looks like every other reed.
intro.name: Ferryman Bo

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: We'll find the channel. Stay close.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Something giggles in the mud.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A lantern bobs over the water, whispering. It says your name. It says it wrong.

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *snaps at the lantern, misses, sulks*

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: The channel! I knew where it was the whole time. Mostly. Here, for your trouble.
outro.name: Ferryman Bo

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: Bo's raft is held together with string and optimism.

name: The Whispering Lights
description: The wisps are leading travelers into the deep marsh. Bo wants to know why.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Three travelers this week, all following lights into the bog. All came back muddy and grumpy.
intro.name: Ferryman Bo

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: Let's follow the lights ourselves.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The lights lead to a clearing. A Reed Stalker stands very still, pretending to be a reed.

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *sniffs the reed. The reed sneezes.*

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: Behind the Reed Stalker the wisps gather around a cracked lantern, flickering and lost.

outro.speaker: rider
outro.text: They're not leading people astray. They're lost too.

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: You could carry the lantern back to Bo. Or set it on the old stone shrine, where the wisps used to rest.

choice.prompt: What do you do with the cracked lantern?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The wisps settle into the shrine with a happy hum. One of them drops a glowing crystal at your feet.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: A real wisp lantern! Collectors pay a fortune for these. Well, a small fortune. Here.
lines.name: Ferryman Bo

name: Toad Trouble
description: The Murk Toads are singing all night. The whole Fen wants to sleep.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: RIBBIT. RIBBIT. All night! I haven't slept since Tuesday!
intro.name: Ferryman Bo

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: Which Tuesday?

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: I don't know anymore!
intro.name: Ferryman Bo

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The choir's conductor appears: a Lily Snapper with a very small baton.

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *tries to eat the baton*

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: The toads fall silent. A huge croak rolls across the marsh from somewhere deeper in.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: That... that's Old Croaker. The toads only sing when she's cranky.
outro.name: Ferryman Bo

name: Old Croaker's Pond
description: Old Croaker is cranky because something is draining her pond. She thinks it's you.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The pond is half empty. Bogling footprints lead everywhere.

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: Someone's been digging channels.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: WHO drains my pond? Was it you? It smells like you.
intro.name: Old Croaker

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: It wasn't us! But we'll prove it.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Prove it by losing!
intro.name: Old Croaker

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: Hmph. You fight like you've got nothing to hide. The water's flowing to the old willow. It's always the willow.
outro.name: Old Croaker

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: Old Croaker gives you a smooth stone. It's warm, and it smells like pond.

choice.prompt: The Boglings dug the channels to water their mushroom farm. What now?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You dig one more channel, so the pond and the farm both get some. The Boglings give you a basket of mushrooms and a very muddy hug.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Ha! My pond! You're all right, keeper.
lines.name: Old Croaker

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Boglings glare at you from the reeds.

name: The Whisperwillow
description: At the heart of the Fen, an ancient willow drinks the marsh dry and whispers about it.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: I'll row you to the heart of the Fen. I'll also row away very fast afterwards.
intro.name: Ferryman Bo

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The guards of the willow rise out of the reeds.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The Whisperwillow towers over a dry, cracked pond. Its branches hiss.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Thirsty. Always thirsty. The marsh is MINE to drink.
intro.name: Whisperwillow

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *growls, then whispers back, which confuses everyone*

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: The willow's roots let go. Water rushes back into the ponds and channels of the Fen.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: Fine. I'll share. But I'm going to complain about it.
outro.name: Whisperwillow

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: The fog's lifting! I can see my house! I can see... three of my houses? Oh, that's just the one, it's very long.
outro.name: Ferryman Bo

outro.speaker: dragon
outro.text: *splashes in the new puddles, completely delighted*

name: The Archivist
description: A gnome historian is studying the ruins. The ruins are studying her back.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Oh, splendid, a dragon keeper! I'm Odd. Archivist Odd. I'm cataloguing the fortress, and the fortress keeps trying to catalogue me.
intro.name: Archivist Odd

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: We'll keep the machines off you.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A Cog Crawler ticks out of a crack in the wall.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: That one's a Brass Sentry. Model seven. Very polite. Very stabby.
intro.name: Archivist Odd

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *sniffs the sentry, gets a static shock, sulks*

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: Marvelous! Three hundred years and they still work. Mostly. Here, a little something from my research budget.
outro.name: Archivist Odd

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: Odd writes 'keeper: useful' in a very small notebook.

name: Steam and Whistles
description: The old boiler room is whistling again. Odd wants to know why. So does everyone's ears.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: The boilers haven't run in centuries, and yet... listen.
intro.name: Archivist Odd

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: WHEEEEEEE. A Boiler Bot waddles out, whistling furiously.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Behind it, a Spark Hound guards the boiler room door, wagging its tail so hard sparks fly.

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *wags back, confused but happy*

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: Inside, the old furnace is lit. Someone has been feeding it coal.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: Fascinating. Something in the fortress is waking up, and it's hungry for fire.
outro.name: Archivist Odd

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: A crate of spare coal sits by the door. Odd's eyes light up. So do the Spark Hounds'.

choice.prompt: The crate of coal: who gets it?

options.label: Feed it to the Spark Hounds

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Spark Hounds crunch the coal happily and follow you around for a bit. One leaves you a shiny scale it found.

options.label: Give it to Odd for her research

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: For science! And also for heating my tea. Take this, I won't need it anymore.
lines.name: Archivist Odd

name: Gargoyle Watch
description: The gargoyles on the walls have started waking up. One at a time. Grumpily.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: The gargoyles were carved to wake if the fortress was in danger. So... is it?
intro.name: Archivist Odd

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A Gargoyle Pup yawns, stretches, and notices you.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Two more pups drop from the battlements. They look extremely awake now.

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *does its best gargoyle impression, perfectly still, fooling no one*

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: The gargoyles only wake when the captain sounds the alarm. And the captain... oh dear. The captain.
outro.name: Archivist Odd

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: A distant bell rings, slightly off-key.

name: Captain Clank
description: The fortress captain has woken up and has orders to follow. Very, very old orders.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: He's in the great hall, rallying the guard. Do be careful, he's very formal about stabbing.
intro.name: Archivist Odd

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A squad of Brass Sentries forms up in the hall.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: HALT! Intruders in the fortress! By order of the King, who is... where is the King?
intro.name: Captain Clank

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: The King's been gone for 300 years, Captain.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Then I shall defend the fortress until he returns! EN GARDE!
intro.name: Captain Clank

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: You fight with honor. The fortress... has no king? Then whom do I serve?
outro.name: Captain Clank

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: Perhaps yourself, Captain? Or perhaps a nice museum?
outro.name: Archivist Odd

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: A museum. I... would like that. Beware the Colossus below. Its furnace has been lit.
outro.name: Captain Clank

choice.prompt: Captain Clank needs a new purpose. What do you suggest?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: A museum guard! I shall salute every visitor. Twice.
lines.name: Captain Clank

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Free security! You're a genius, keeper.
lines.name: Archivist Odd

options.label: Train with you at the Roost

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: A sparring partner for your dragon! I accept. I shall be gentle. I shall not be gentle.
lines.name: Captain Clank

lines.speaker: dragon
lines.text: *looks thrilled and slightly worried*

name: The Cinderforge Colossus
description: Deep under the ruins, the fortress's last guardian has stoked its furnace. It wants to rebuild the walls. With you inside them.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: The forge hall. The Colossus is down there. I'll be up here. Taking notes. From a distance.
intro.name: Archivist Odd

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The forge's guard hounds come bounding up the stairs.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The Cinderforge Colossus rises from the forge, stone hands glowing, furnace roaring in its chest.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: WALLS. MUST. BE. REBUILT.
intro.name: Cinderforge Colossus

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *growls at the heat, then sneezes a puff of smoke back at it*

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: The Colossus's furnace sputters out with a long, tired sigh. It sits down, very gently, and goes back to sleep.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: History made! And written down! Mostly legible!
outro.name: Archivist Odd

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: The fortress is at peace. Museum hours begin at nine.
outro.name: Captain Clank

outro.speaker: dragon
outro.text: *curls up next to the warm forge, very pleased*

name: The Lamplighter
description: Someone keeps blowing out the lanterns in Moonwell Woods. Lamplighter Nell is not amused.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Every lantern I light, something puffs it out! Every single one!
intro.name: Lamplighter Nell

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: We'll keep watch while you work.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Two big round eyes blink in the dark. Hoo.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A Frostcap Shroom sits on the lantern post, glowing smugly.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: That's not a lantern. That's a mushroom pretending to be a lantern.
intro.name: Lamplighter Nell

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *bonks the mushroom, gets bonked back*

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: The path is lit! Thank you, keeper. Here, take some lamp money. Don't spend it all on lamps.
outro.name: Lamplighter Nell

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: The lanterns flicker on, one by one, down the long dark path.

name: Gossip in the Trees
description: The trees are spreading rumors about you. Some of them are even true.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: The trees have been talking. They say you snore. They say your dragon eats lanterns.
intro.name: Lamplighter Nell

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *quietly hides a lantern behind its back*

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A Snickerbark giggles from behind a log.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The rumor trail leads to a ring of Snickerbarks telling spooky stories around a cold blue fire.

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: That's where the gossip starts.

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: The Snickerbarks huddle together, giggling nervously.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: Okay, okay! We'll stop! But only if you tell us a scary story first. A good one.
outro.name: Snickerbark

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: They're not bad, just bored. And loud.
outro.name: Lamplighter Nell

choice.prompt: The Snickerbarks want a scary story. What do you tell them?

options.label: Tell them a truly scary story

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Your story is so scary the Snickerbarks hide under their own roots for a week. One of them leaves you a shiny scale as a peace offering.

options.label: Tell them a funny one instead

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Snickerbarks laugh so hard their leaves fall off. They promise to gossip only nice things from now on.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Nice gossip! Imagine that.
lines.name: Lamplighter Nell

name: The Sock Thief
description: Every camper's socks are missing. Nell suspects the foxes. Nell suspects everyone.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: I put my socks by the fire. In the morning? Gone. All of them. Even the itchy ones.
intro.name: Lamplighter Nell

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A Shadow Fox trots past with a striped sock in its mouth.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The fox leads you to a burrow. A Rimeback Badger is sitting on a huge pile of socks, looking extremely guilty.

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *sniffs the pile, sneezes, looks offended*

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: The badger has been using the socks to stay warm all winter. It looks very cold now.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: Oh, you poor thing. Fine. You can keep the itchy ones.
outro.name: Lamplighter Nell

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: Under the socks: a little stash of iron ore and a very old lantern.

name: The Great Stag
description: Duskhorn, the stag who guards the moonwell, has stopped letting anyone near it.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Duskhorn always lets travelers drink from the moonwell. Now he charges anyone who tries.
intro.name: Lamplighter Nell

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The forest guards the path: owls in the branches, mushrooms in the roots.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Duskhorn steps out of the mist, stars caught in his antlers, eyes cold.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: The well is not safe. Something sleeps in it that should not wake. Turn back.
intro.name: Duskhorn

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: Then let us help.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: You are strong. Perhaps strong enough. The Wyrm in the well has been stealing the forest's dreams. That is why the trees gossip and the foxes steal. Nobody sleeps.
outro.name: Duskhorn

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: No wonder I've been so tired!
outro.name: Lamplighter Nell

choice.prompt: Duskhorn offers you a gift for the road. Which do you take?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Carry it into the dark. It will not go out.
lines.name: Duskhorn

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Duskhorn touches his nose to your dragon's. Your dragon stands a little taller, and very still, and very proud.

name: The Moonwell Wyrm
description: Deep in the moonwell sleeps a serpent of night sky, and it has been eating everyone's dreams.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: I'll light the way to the well. After that, you're on your own. I'll be over here. Holding a lantern. Supportively.
intro.name: Lamplighter Nell

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The well's last guards slip out of the shadows.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The moonwell glows. The water rises, and rises, and becomes a long serpent made of stars.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Sssleep. Dream for me. I'm ssso hungry for dreams.
intro.name: Moonwell Wyrm

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *yawns, then shakes it off and growls*

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: The Moonwell Wyrm sinks back into the water, full and drowsy, and lets the stolen dreams drift up like fireflies.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: Look! They're going home. Every dream in the forest.
outro.name: Lamplighter Nell

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: The woods will sleep tonight. Thank you, keeper.
outro.name: Duskhorn

outro.speaker: dragon
outro.text: *falls asleep on the spot and snores, very loudly*
